evals.name: live-queries
evals.prompt: The conversation slice has generated Topics and Messages queries. Messages requires topicId. Bind them to the sidebar.
evals.expected_output: Import Topics and Messages from generated/Features/Conversations.
assertions: Passes Topics and Messages to topicsQuery and messagesQuery.
Returns undefined from messagesArguments for no selected topic.
Builds the topicId argument from the selected ID.

evals.name: hide-chat
evals.prompt: Hide the chat panel without stopping topic updates or requesting all conversations.
evals.expected_output: Visibility changes without unmounting the query adapter.
assertions: Renders the sidebar while open is false.
Connects open and onClose to the host.
Loads messages only for the displayed topic.

evals.name: send-message
evals.prompt: Connect the send callback so a request still belongs to its original conversation after switching topics.
evals.expected_output: Deliver the body and mentions with the callback's topic ID.
assertions: Supplies onSendMessage with topicId, body and mentions.
Uses that ID rather than reading a later selection.
Handles the failed send in the host and identifies the originating topic.
